text: Quantifiable outcomes are pending post-implementation monitoring, expected to commence after the effective date of 1 April 2025. Anticipated results include increased uptake of resilience measures, more granular risk-differentiated pricing, and potential reductions in cyclone-related claims severity and frequency for participating strata portfolios.

metadata.solution_name: Cyclone Reinsurance Pool Strata Mitigation Discounts (CRP Strata Mitigation Discounts)
